englishTranslation: Green papaya salad with dried beef
atAGlance: Nộm bò khô is dried beef salad, usually with green papaya, herbs, peanuts, and tangy dressing.
whatItIs: Nộm bò khô is northern-style green papaya salad with dried beef, herbs, peanuts, and a tart-sweet dressing. It is chewy, crunchy, tangy, and snacky.
howToEnjoy: Mix the dried beef through the papaya so each bite gets chew, crunch, herbs, and dressing. Ask for less chili before it is tossed.
howLocalsOrder: Order nộm bò khô as a snack plate. Say không đậu phộng or ít cay before the vendor adds peanuts and chili.
worthKnowing: Nộm is the northern word travelers often see for salad; this one is more street-snack than leafy salad.
goodToKnow: This Hanoi-style snack is about dried beef, green papaya, herbs, peanuts, and chili. Ask ít cay or không đậu phộng before mixing.

orderLine.vietnamese: Cho tôi một phần nộm bò khô.
orderLine.english: I’d like one order of green papaya salad with dried beef.
orderLine.pronunciation: chaw toy moht fuhn nohm baw koh
